visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-definition close-up of a person's hands pulling apart a golden-brown, crispy pastry. The interior reveals a soft, pale, chewy texture that stretches slightly. The lighting is bright and directional, emphasizing the texture of the crust. (2) A transition to an overhead shot shows a metal sieve over a glass bowl. A person is sifting white flour; a detailed text overlay list of ingredients appears on the right. The background is a clean, wooden countertop in a bright studio setting. (3) A series of close-up shots follow: a spoon adding yellow milk powder, a hand pouring sugar, and a glass pitcher pouring white milk into the bowl. A metal whisk enters the frame to stir the mixture into a smooth, pale batter. (4) The person uses both hands to tightly cover the glass bowl with two layers of transparent plastic wrap, pressing it against the rim. (5) Close-up shot of a hand using a yellow silicone brush to spread thick yellow butter into black flower-shaped and shell-shaped baking molds. (6) A medium-shot shows the main character, a male chef in a white professional uniform, standing before a white brick wall, explaining the process with hand gestures. (7) The chef pours the batter from a glass measuring cup into the buttered molds, filling them nearly to the brim. (8) The molds are placed on a tray and slid into a small oven. The heating elements glow orange, creating high-contrast lighting. (9) The final shot returns to the hands tearing the finished, golden-brown cake, showcasing the crispy exterior and moist interior under bright studio lights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, percussive 'crunch' sound opens the track. A male voice introduces the dish name with clear enunciation. High-energy electronic BGM with a bright synth lead and rhythmic drums begins immediately. (2) Vocal narrative continues as a series of short 'swish' and 'clink' SFX mark the sifting and adding of ingredients. The BGM remains constant at 124 BPM, maintaining a positive, upbeat drive. (3) Soft 'sloshing' and 'pouring' SFX occur as liquids are added, perfectly mixed with the narrator's professional and friendly tone. The BGM provides a stable rhythmic floor. (4) Distinct 'rustling' sound of plastic wrap being manipulated. The narrator explains the sealing step with moderate pitch variability. (5) Whisking SFX create a rhythmic scraping against glass. Narrator emphasizes the texture of the batter. (6) Sound of a brush 'scratching' on a metal surface. The narrator suggests using a thick layer of butter. (7) 'Glug' sounds of pouring thick batter into molds. BGM synth melody continues in a major mode. (8) A metallic 'click' and 'clunk' as the oven rack is moved and the door shut. BGM energy is sustained. (9) The audio concludes with a final loud 'crunch' sound (transient impact) as the pastry is pulled apart, followed by a brief concluding phrase from the narrator.
